gate3.note: No core filter was added; broad-market sleeve remains default-off paper only.

hypothesis: Broad-market leadership paper candidates may work best when the same-day opportunity set is broad enough to show real market participation. A minimum candidate-count gate may avoid thin, idiosyncratic leadership days without adding noisy tickers.
interpretation: Candidate breadth is a production-visible market-participation proxy. Because this still changes frozen broad-market paper selection, no shared adapter is changed unless the strict materiality gate clears.

llm_metrics.reason: This run avoids sparse LLM soft-ranking and does not alter LLM prompts or decisions.

next_evidence_needed: If forward broad-market paper rows show thin-breadth days driving losses, retest with live ledger replacement-value evidence before enabling any shared selection rule.

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool/ranking: same-day candidate breadth can identify when broad-market leadership is broad participation rather than isolated idiosyncratic momentum.
protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: Broad-market price-floor, rank-notional, low-extension, high-volatility, trend-persistence, score-gap, correlation crowding, and return-path cluster fields were tested. Candidate breadth gating has not been formalized for this sleeve.
protocol_answers.3_single_variable: Only min_day_candidate_count changes; universe, eligibility profile, rank profile, accepted notional scalars, hold, slots, and candidate source stay fixed.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance: Gate 4 requires positive aggregate EV/PnL, all 3 windows EV-positive, no EV/PnL regression windows, >=4 changed trades across >=2 windows, concentration guard, <=0.5pp drawdown worsening, identity control, and >=10% aggregate EV improvement because this is a frozen-sample broad-market selection retune.
protocol_answers.5_reproducibility: Script, JSON artifact, log, ticket, markdown artifact, and JSONL identify windows, parameters, selected/blocked examples, and metrics.

rejection_reason: Candidate-breadth gating did not clear the strict three-window broad-market materiality gate.
single_causal_variable: minimum same-day count of fixed-profile broad-market candidates required before opening new default-off paper entries
